concerns.text: FR-004 requires computing per‑patient linear slopes of UPDRS Part III scores, yet the project's verified PPMI datasets (see research.md) do not contain any longitudinal UPDRS III measurements. Without a source for this primary outcome, the core hypothesis (taxa abundance ↔ progression rate) is untestable, violating the functional requirement and rendering the validation target undefined.

FR-005 builds a Linear Mixed‑Effects Model with `UPDRS` as the dependent variable, again assuming availability of longitudinal UPDRS III scores. Since these scores are absent from the verified data, the model cannot be fit, making the claimed validation circular (predictor and outcome are the same unavailable variable).
